analysis_set.span: The primary outcome was the first occurrence of the composite endpoint of non-fatal myocardial infarction, non-fatal stroke, or death from cardiovascular causes (including unknown causes), which was assessed in the intention-to-treat population.

follow_up.span: During a median follow-up of 5·4 years (IQR 5·1-5·9)

entry_age.span: Men and women aged at least 50 years with type 2 diabetes

notes: The packet contains two abstract sources and a registry source, but no held_local/...html full text despite the brief. The primary outcome explicitly uses intention-to-treat analysis; follow-up is median duration, not a fixed assessment timepoint. Entry requires type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease or risk factors, a subset of the question population rather than an outside population.
